newsitem.title: USA: Brite Voice starts Spanish audiotex network.
newsitem.headline: Brite Voice starts Spanish audiotex network.

text.p: Brite Voice Systems Inc said Friday it started a Spanish-language audiotex network in North America that provides Spanish-speaking consumers with news, weather, entertainment and stock quotes.
The company will collaborate with Call 511, a South Florida information provider, to produce the Spanish content.
Brite Voice said it has begun offering the service to its customer base, including newspaper and yellow pages publishers, radio and television stations and pay-per-call information providers.
